title: nominationTimeSeries
description: Nomination time series for one external account and one nomination period.

externalAccount.description: Identifier of the corresponding external account or matching counterpart.

values.description: Chronologically ordered hourly nomination values. Each value represents the quantity for the interval beginning at timestamp. The interval duration is defined by nominationData.granularity.

quantity.description: Non-negative whole-number nomination quantity in the unit defined by nominationData.unit.

flowDirection.description: Direction of the nominated hydrogen flow.

x-enumDescriptions.Entry: Flow into the relevant network, system or balancing group.
x-enumDescriptions.Exit: Flow out of the relevant network, system or balancing group.
